correctness.rationale: The six disjoint (H,CNOT) gate pairs prepare Phi+ tensor six. Independent X(p) errors on both ends of a Bell pair give Psi+ with q=2p(1-p), so Bell correction implements X(q) per teleported qubit. Source Eq.(36) factorizes as |+>_2 tensor [a|00>+sqrt(1-a^2)|01>+sqrt(1-a^2)|10>+a|11>]/sqrt(2); the second party at b=1/sqrt(2) is |+>^3. Overlaps of the two entangled qubits with XX equal 1, with a single X equal 2a sqrt(1-a^2). Summing two independent error parities proves F_Bi=1-2q(1-q)(2a^2-1)^2. At (p,a)=(1/2,0) F=1/2. A common Kraus index gives total norm ((1-p)^12+p^12)I, not CPTP in the interior; a separately defined correlated global-X channel differs. Independent exact rational checks on 25 parameter pairs corroborate, not replace, this symbolic proof.
